गुल (लः) 1.
m. Raw or unrefined
sugar.
f. ला A plant; ली a pill;
a disease, the small-pox.

गुलञ्च-कन्द (न्दः) 1.
m. An esculent root^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

गुलिका-क्रीडा (डा) 1.
f. Playing at
bat and ball, golf, &c.

गुलुच्छ (च्छः) 1.
m. A cluster of
blossoms; a nosegay.

गुल्म (ल्मः) 1.
m. The division of
an army, 9 elephants, 9 cha-
riots, 27 horse, and 45 foot; a
shrub; a fort; the spleen; a
disease; discipline; a
ghāt. (ल्मी)
f. A tent; a thicket.

गुल्मिन् (ल्मी-ल्मिनी-ल्मि)
a. Having divi-
sions, clumps or clusters, spleen,
&c. (नी)
f. A spreading creep-
er, or any creeping plant.
